notes.subject: ואני תפלה
notes.rationale: literal 'but I — prayer', an ellipsis; alternatives: 'I am all prayer' (JPS), 'I give myself to prayer' (KJV), 'I am a man of prayer' (BSB)

notes.subject: ישטנוני
notes.rationale: verb שׂטן 'to accuse' occurs as a verb only here in the Tanakh — the root otherwise names the accuser, satan

notes.subject: שטנ/אהב
notes.rationale: love answered by accusation, the two roots set in deliberate opposition across the verse

translation: N'ka kanuya nɔ na, u bɛ n fɔ ɲɛ-jaw la; n ye ⟨donibaga⟩ ye.

tokens.gloss: u bɛ n fɔ ɲɛ-jaw la
